nonClaimNotice: This is a read-only official Ontario route-exhaustion and current-availability record. It does not claim that a public web map, a pilot sample, or a mutable FMU boundary service is a complete Term 2 FRI package, a reproducible snapshot, a final schema, source-ledger evidence, or production authorization.

geoHubPage.finding: The page is an authoritative direction and status page, not a complete Term 2 package. Its one-year range-label conflict is unresolved by a publisher version or as-of record.

routes.blocker: Exactly two WEB resources are listed; resource size, package bytes, checksum, schema, CRS and complete export are absent.
The page says T2 is in production, points to an incomplete Romeo Malette pilot and says products will be added as available; it provides no final Term 2 package.
Only two operational boundary layers are present. The map's own description calls linked FRI packages draft and non-final.
The 39-feature polygon service identifies FMUs but carries no Term 2 stand attributes or package snapshot.
The one feature is explicitly a review subset and exposes only two sample links, not a complete provincial or selected-FMU Term 2 release.
The two public ZIPs are pilot sample products; only HEAD metadata was read, no archive was downloaded, and neither is a complete Term 2 package.
The route is T1/FIMv2 (2008–2017) and its 78 direct ZIP links have explicit filename vintages 2007–2016; it cannot establish Term 2 access.

artifacts.publisherLabel: Romeo Malette Forest Predictors (20m) Sample Set

findings.dateLabelConflictReason: The page's program-overview text says 2018–2027 while its inventory-development card, catalogue and Web Map title say 2018–2028. No publisher version/as-of statement resolves the discrepancy.
findings.conclusion: No complete, final, checksum-bound and coherently reproducible Term 2 FRI package is publicly available through the official Ontario routes inspected. The only public data payloads are incomplete pilot samples for one FMU, and they remain unprofiled because this audit did not download them.

rights.reason: The catalogue and Web Map advertise OGL Ontario, but the linked FRI products are explicitly draft consultation/product-development samples with changing attributes, algorithms and formats. No final Term 2 package licence, attribution wording, version or checksum was published; retain the existing exact-package rights blocker.

steps: Ask the Ontario FRI team to identify whether a final Term 2 release exists beyond the public pilot and, if so, provide the stable package or documented deterministic export route.
Request the exact edition/version, as-of date, complete FMU coverage list, format, CRS, schema, feature count, byte length, SHA-256 and archive-integrity evidence.

Request written confirmation of the licence and attribution for the exact package, including retention, internal transformation, public redistribution, refresh, correction and right-of-reply conditions.
Ask the publisher to resolve the public 2018–2027 versus 2018–2028 range labels and state whether Romeo Malette FMU 930 is only a pilot or a final release.
Keep on-fri and on-fri-term-2 access-blocked until a complete coherent package and exact-package rights are verified.
